technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochastic reversal signal, but severe bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, weak volume) and lack of trend confirmation make this a low-probability entry.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295), FOMC event in 1 day creates binary event risk, and macro score of -7 indicates highly unfavourable conditions.
